# It Looks Like Canon Has a Hit on Its Hands With the EOS R8 Mark II

 News Nov 23, 2026 Jeremy Gray 

Yodobashi Camera, one of Japan’s largest photo retailers, has shared its latest camera sales charts, and the results are great news for Canon. 

Yodobashi’s new sales charts cover the second half of October — Yodobashi, unlike Map Camera, does biweekly sales recaps. While sales charts for an individual photo retail chain in Japan do not necessarily capture the behavior of the global market, Yodobashi caters primarily to enthusiast and professional customers, so the results are always interesting and, frankly, some of the only data that the industry has access to anyway. 

On the camera side of things, the Canon EOS R8 Mark II made its debut in Japanese stores. Canon’s new “entry-level” full-frame camera, which PetaPixel really likes, struck a chord with customers, too. 

 

As CAPA Camera Web reports, the R8 II went on sale in Japan only on October 29, giving it just three days to surge up the sales charts to the No. 2 position, just behind the Sony a7 V. As PetaPixel has reported numerous times, the Sony a7 V has been an extremely successful and popular camera in its first year. Perhaps the radically redesigned, impressive R8 II could knock the a7 V off its perch with more time on store shelves. 

 

It is worth noting, though, that Yodobashi separates body-only sales and kit sales in its charts. The Canon EOS R8 II body finished second, but the kit with the RF 24-105mm f/4-7.1 IS STM lens was in fourth, and the kit with Canon's popular, budget-friendly RF 45mm f/1.2 lens was in the ninth spot. Perhaps if all R8 II configurations were counted together, the a7 V would have lost its top spot after all. 

Both Sony and Canon scored other cameras on the list, including the a7C II for Sony and the EOS R10 and EOS R50 for Canon. The Fujifilm X-M5 kit with the XC 15-45mm f/3.5-5.6 finished third, and the X-T30 III with the XC 13-33mm f/3.5-6.3 landed in sixth.

# It Looks Like Canon Has a Hit on Its Hands With the EOS R8 Mark II
![A black Canon EOS mirrorless camera body is centered against a background of out-of-focus, sparkling red lights.](https://petapixel.com/assets/uploads/2026/11/canon-camera-sales-yodobashi-oct-featured-800x420.jpg)
Yodobashi Camera, one of Japan’s largest photo retailers, has shared its latest camera sales charts, and the results are great news for Canon.

As *CAPA Camera Web* [reports](https://getnavi.jp/capa/news/511196/), the R8 II went on sale in Japan only on October 29, giving it just three days to surge up the sales charts to the No. 2 position, just behind the Sony a7 V. As *PetaPixel* has reported numerous times, the Sony a7 V has been an [extremely successful and popular camera](https://petapixel.com/2026/09/14/the-sony-a7-v-has-been-topped-the-charts-for-7-of-the-first-8-months-of-2026/) in its first year. The Canon EOS R8 Mark II is a mid-range full-frame mirrorless camera with IBIS and an angular design reminiscent of vintage Canon film SLRs and, dare I say, a current rival brand. Meanwhile the old R8 will remain on sale as a more affordable option especially with holiday discounts, so the new Mark II slots between it and the R6 II in the series. 日本知名相机零售商Map Camera近日公布了2026年10月数码相机销量Top 10榜单。这份基于实际零售数据的排名，往往比厂商出货数据更能反映终端市场的真实情况。本期榜单最大的意外来自佳能——9月中旬才发布、10月底才正式出货的EOS R8 Mark II，上市首月便直接 ※※ 榜首，将此前长期霸榜的索尼A7M5挤到了第二位。
Map Camera 2026年10月相机销量Top10
Map Camera 2026年10月相机销量Top10
冠军易主： EOS R8 Mark II 的 “ 补课式 ” 升级奏效
Map Camera在榜单解读中直言，10月的新品排名出现了“真正令人震惊的变化”，并将EOS R8 Mark II的登顶形容为“佳能的回归重击”。这款相机在日本市场的单机身含税定价为 275,000 日元，约合 11,626 元人民币。国行版本已于 9月16日发布，单机身售价 9,999元，日本地区的正式出货日期为10月底。
EOS R8 Mark II的热销并非偶然。行业评测普遍指出，这款机型“几乎修复了用户对初代R8的所有最大抱怨”：新增了五轴机身防抖和对焦摇杆，同时保留了前代那块2420万像素全画幅CMOS与DIGIC X处理器。换句话说，佳能没有在核心画质上另起炉灶，而是精准补上了初代R8在操控与手持稳定性上的两块最短木板。Map Camera特别提到，搭配轻薄定焦镜头RF 45mm f/1.2 STM的套机销售速度“几乎与单机身一样快”，说明不少用户是直接冲着“一步到位”的轻便全画幅方案来的。
索尼仍稳，佳能四席入榜
索尼A7M5让出榜首，但并不意味着失速。这款3300万像素全画幅无反自去年12月以来已9次登顶Map Camera月榜，上市近一年仍能维持第二名的销量水平，本身已是相当强势的长线表现。其日本市场单机身含税价约为378,500日元，折合人民币约16,003元。索尼A7C II与A6700也继续留在前十，索尼在榜单中仍占据三席，基本盘并未松动。
佳能方面则凭借EOS R8 Mark II的爆发，在前十中一举拿下4款产品：除了榜首的EOS R8 Mark II，还有PowerShot SX740 HS、PowerShot G7 X Mark III，以及排在第10位的EOS R6 Mark II。从全画幅新机到便携卡片机再到中端全画幅，佳能在这个月的终端覆盖面上明显更宽。
便携相机热度不减，三款卡片机同进前十
值得单独拎出来说的是，本期榜单中有三款便携式数码相机同时进入前十：理光 GR IV（第 4）、佳能PowerShot SX740 HS（第 5）和 PowerShot G7 X Mark III（第 7）。在无反相机占据绝对主流话语权的当下，三款卡片机同台出现在销量前十，指向的是一个持续存在的细分需求——用户愿意为一台能随身放进口袋、开机即拍的机器买单，而且这种需求并不因手机摄影的进步而消失。
EOS R8 Mark II的首月登顶，本质上是一次“产品定义纠偏”的胜利。初代R8以低价全画幅切入市场，却在机身防抖和操控摇杆上留下了过于明显的缺口，导致它在与同价位竞品的对比中始终差一口气。EOS R8 Mark II把这两块短板补齐之后，产品逻辑立刻变得完整：用户不需要再在“便宜的全画幅”和“好用的全画幅”之间做取舍。至于这种势头能否从首销月的脉冲式放量转化为持续的长线销量，接下来两到三个月的榜单会给出更诚实的答案。

# It Looks Like Canon Has a Hit on Its Hands With the EOS R8 Mark II
![A black Canon EOS mirrorless camera body is centered against a background of out-of-focus, sparkling red lights.](https://petapixel.com/assets/uploads/2026/11/canon-camera-sales-yodobashi-oct-featured-800x420.jpg)
Yodobashi Camera, one of Japan’s largest photo retailers, has shared its latest camera sales charts, and the results are great news for Canon.

As *CAPA Camera Web* [reports](https://getnavi.jp/capa/news/511196/), the R8 II went on sale in Japan only on October 29, giving it just three days to surge up the sales charts to the No. 2 position, just behind the Sony a7 V. As *PetaPixel* has reported numerous times, the Sony a7 V has been an [extremely successful and popular camera](https://petapixel.com/2026/09/14/the-sony-a7-v-has-been-topped-the-charts-for-7-of-the-first-8-months-of-2026/) in its first year. Perhaps the radically redesigned, impressive R8 II could knock the a7 V off its perch with more time on store shelves.
It is worth noting, though, that Yodobashi separates body-only sales and kit sales in its charts. The Canon EOS R8 II body finished second, but the kit with the RF 24-105mm f/4-7.1 IS STM lens was in fourth, and the kit with Canon's popular, budget-friendly RF 45mm f/1.2 lens was in the ninth spot. Perhaps if all R8 II configurations were counted together, the a7 V would have lost its top spot after all.
Both Sony and Canon scored other cameras on the list, including the a7C II for Sony and the EOS R10 and EOS R50 for Canon. The Fujifilm X-M5 kit with the XC 15-45mm f/3.5-5.6 finished third, and the X-T30 III with the XC 13-33mm f/3.5-6.3 landed in sixth.
